notes.title: v1.0.16 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed a softlock on the deck selection screen after the winter level.

If you ended the winter level with at least one [spoiler]curse card[/spoiler] and no surplus of supply. Then you would always get soft locked, because the game was counting the [spoiler]curse cards[/spoiler] as a card you could select. But the code was correctly not displaying them.

notes.title: Demo build v0.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey!! This is the biggest demo update ever! 

Since there are so many changes, I tried to only list important stuff here.

Most of this past year has been spent working on content for the full game. This paid content will only be available in the final game: 
entities, planes, occult tech tree, fully explorable starting area, multiple maps / level locations, last level, more puzzles, achievements, and some more secret stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/f25af9616b8f4ccdb78d595c6d22cf59b6b54487.png[/img]

But enough has changed that I wanted to do a giant demo update for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/bf1439f3e5dad997bb72827a7c746acdd49cf456.png[/img]



[h2]New Feature Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trail Calendar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/1ff570c0a6bf0521d22b8c48e2c2780a710ef3de.png[/img]
[*] Party must now eat food as they travel across the trail
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/51ccdeb1e5503436c70d750461f3f55cacea6364.png[/img]
[*] River crossings
[*] Totally revamped outline shader
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/464087abe9e775c52db4b707272fe18498df66d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/786c70aea5fc4d64f05ffa06de7f679632c452b7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/e8212032180c12913eae037732b14e2a17ab2cd2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/bc44ff174a448d1fea4fdfd45c53aa99e35b22cc.png[/img]
[*] Level effect cards that give unique buffs / de-buffs per level
[*] Recipe book has clickable index tabs, and book can also be lowered / raised
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/a0eacf43818c18b36ac70f318fd3c97aaac7179f.png[/img]

[*] You can zoom and drag around the camera in the cardgame view
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/524d8be8740c6225740f6344a0e9f5a60aaa4980.png[/img]
[*] Captain's Log of important events
[*] Tombstones now appear on the map as party members die
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/925e0480193cbaadf69d8023132c0138da48160e.png[/img]
[*] A ton of performance improvements for decks with many cards
[*] Stacks can be accordioned with right mouse click to take up less space
[*] Stack cards by cardtype and number their count when displaying full deck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/9f882543ee776c6bbfd1224e46a3acf1bb554063.png[/img]
[*] Cooking
[*] Steam CloudSaves
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cardgame day / night music
[*] New random encounters
[*] Revamped weather system that changes as calendar progresses
[*] New cards (Toolbox, Silo, Messhall, Oven etc)
[*] Time control keyboard shortcuts are more standard (1, 2, 3), and toggling pause will return you to your previously used speed 
[*] [spoiler]You can kill yourself now[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Player can now die in firepit (and have a new unique cardgame starting party)[/spoiler]
[*] Expand deck area playing card volume so that the book can be moved over to the right more
[*] A lot of behind the scenes plumbing to pave the way for localizations
[*] Music volume setting
[*] Add aspect ratio drop down + only show supported aspect ratios on settings page
[*] [spoiler]Add cutscene after stick drawing sequence[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]New game over cutscene[/spoiler]
[*] Fix a lot of models to work well with new shader
[*] Improved dialogue everywhere
[*] Real Oregon Trail forts and rivers are now named on the map
[*] Lots and lots of recipe book improvements
[*] Re-work illness system to be less dumb (still more work to do there)
[*] Smooth out lantern movement
[*] Fix encounter models clipping sometimes
[*] Card's equip / status cards now have collision and wont clip with other cards
[*] Make card food, building and human types more visually distinct 
[*] Show a hand grabbing cursor when dragging camera / book
[*] When eating at night dont take food from active recipes if there is other food anywhere
[*] Seeds / bones popping out from eating will never join a stack that has an active recipe even if there is no space to pop off
[*] Added MAX SUPPLY card that pops out of the altar as a visual / audio cue when we are out of supply
[*] Added a visual indication that we are hovering over a map location
[*] Controls menu
[/list]



[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix bug where you can flip wagon over on map by hovering / unhovering too quickly
[*] Fix issue when boosterpacks first spawn from the deck, they have the wrong initial z index 
[*] Fix bug where you can game over while cardgame is running and the cards will still simulate
[*] Pressing back button on settings menu now reverts the resolution / display mode
[*] Fix issue where you could pick up the book before the cardgame loads and the pages are blank
[*] Fix issue where main menu was partially hidden on certain resolutions
[*] Fix bug where end of level card was clipping with boosters
[*] [spoiler]Handle puzzle reward is hard to click[/spoiler]
[*] Fix fun bug where you can turn the camera upside down by pressing the W button immediately after clicking the talking board
[*] Fix a couple of bugs around selecting cards for the next level
[*] Fix issue where you could click the wagon while its moving across the map
[*] Fixed bug where you could load a save file at night and immediately move the camera back when you werent supposed to if you spammed S key
[*] Recipe names on hover weren't showing in total darkness
[*] Fix some nighttime crashes
[*] You can no longer interact with cards if you are standing up 
[*] Dragging cards out of fortboard trader didnt have a concurrency cap and sounded hilarious
[*] Selling a card that was removed from a container at the fortboard trader wasnt actually removing that card from the container after selling
[*] Fix multiple issues with clicking booster packs (ex: can pick up boosters while clicking on recipe book, could click on cards underneath booster, but not booster even when booster was on top of cards)
[*] Fixed lots of card clipping issues / revamped collision system
[*] If you step away from cardgame area while moving a stack / booster we drop them
[*] Fix infinite card rotate hover bug
[*] Fixed issue where if a card is merging with a stack and you click a card in the target stack, then the moving card drops and is not clickable until you load the game
[*] If you dropped an active recipe stack onto another stack then the card above it couldn't be clicked bc the collision of the progress bar is still blocking
[*] Fix crash when a party member in an active recipe stack dies from an illness mid recipe
[*] Humans and animals now always return to their original stack after they wake up, even if their source stack was emptied totally
[*] Reworked next level wagon, party, ox card displays since they looked bad when you have too many cards
[/list]




[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pen cards only hold 10 animals at night, not infinite
[*] Players can now select 2 boosters at the start
[*] [spoiler]Altar blood cost now scales as you use it more[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Exploring now has a small chance for a good / bad outcome[/spoiler]
[*] Lots of balance changes to booster pack odds
[*] Lots of new cards in all booster packs
[*] Animals no longer take a space in wagons on the trail (they walk on the side of the wagons like party members)
[*] Hemp is more common in booster packs
[*] Traps trigger more frequently
[*] Goats auto pop out milk periodically like eggs with chickens, instead of needing to be manually milked
[*] All starter packs have much better cards in them
[*] Less eggs in woods booster pack
[/list]

Thank you for reading this far :]. I am working hard on the final version of the game, stay tuned for a launch date announcement!

Hop in the discord if you find any bugs / have any comments on the game especially the new systems!

This demo update is so large that I just started a new demo save file, so your progress wont carry over from the older demo build. (I will never do this for the paid game).






<3 de_husk

notes.title: Demo build v0.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New year, new WAGON update!

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Let players move the recipe book
[*] Altar booster packs now have their names on the covers so that people know what they are choosing at the start of each game
[*] 'Barn' card has been renamed to 'Shed' since people thought the Barn was the Pen. 
[*] The old Barn image is now the Farm card image since the old Farm card was not unique enough
[*] Show the reason recipes can't craft in recipe progress bar ('frozen', 'broken', etc)
[*] Add initial credits screen
[*] Fix sounds overlapping and clipping by setting sound concurrency limits on sounds that will play simultaneously 
[*] When popping cards off stacks, prefer eligible containers to eligible stacks
[*] When popping cards off stacks, prefer the CLOSEST eligible container / stack to merge
[*] Cleanup some models / textures
[*] Lighting pass in stick drawing section + main menu
[*] Auto close recipe book when the camera moves away from cardgame view
[*] Recipe book is now only clickable from the cardgame view
[*] Actually implement a real global barn / wagon supply cap
[*] Foodbox 'meals stashed' recipe book hud was confusing and I replaced it with a simple 'STARVING'/'FULL' message
[*] Default the time lever out of cardgame setting to paused, instead of play
[/list]


[h2]Bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix bug where a resolution much larger than the max monitor resolution was being initially set when using multiple monitors
[*] Now if a save file contains a resolution unsupported by this monitor, it resets it to the largest currently supported resolution
[*] Fix card popping race condition where cards will move to the same spot and clip
[*] Fix issue where sometimes cards will not merge into an eligible stack
[*] Fix issue where stack will bug out if you move a stack that has a card in transit
[*] Fix bug where sometimes during feeding, the original stacks where the food cards popped off of would move after the food cards were eaten
[*] Fix bug where you can break a stick in the intro cutscene after someone draws a stick
[*] Center more HUD items
[*] Fix issue where equipped cards will clip with the left wagon wall for ultrawide monitors
[*] Fix settings bug where the volume would get reset to MAX if you changed the color palette
[*] Fixed issue where the commodore palette button didnt have a sound effect
[*] Fixed issue where the stitches of the booster packs would sometimes become invisible if you moved them around
[/list]


[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] The coat is a lot more useful now - before it was only adding 1 warmth when it gained warmth. Now it permanently increases its outer temp level by 1.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo build v0.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Howdy wagoneers! I'm excited to announce the biggest WAGON demo update yet! 

Forts, multiple maps, revamped encounters, equippable cards, new dialogue system, ultrawide support and more! 

The game is feeling way more oregon traily now, and I hope you enjoy all of the changes and fixes as much as I am.

Since people have been asking me how to play the new tutorial, and the new multi-map system breaks the old saves, I decided to just reset everyone to a new save instead of supporting the legacy map system since it's just the demo. I will always be backwards compatible in the final paid version though.

I have also pushed back the final launch date to Q1 2024, I will give a more final date once I get closer to finishing.


[h2]Improvements[/h2] 

[list]
[*] Forts on the trail where you can rest and repair! - Trading, Supplying, Repairing, new card fanning system
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/4369ac20c2582a89e3cb6c341caf16432e2b2941.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/0748cb60e0f0b5a90b6288b2fec26f714e06fd1e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Multiple Maps with different biomes to give true Oregon Trail experience
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/d54a55a237707f685b6f8387f73720f3ac990d7b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Revamped Encounters: Scenary for the biome of the current map, sound effects, new card fanning system, Wagon that moves across the screen like the new forts
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/b1b2a5bf0d7d130a829e53156aee3feae89e9f58.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New Equippable Card Type:  Humans can equip cards to boost passive stats
[/list] 

 Coat [++ WARM]
 Amulet [+ HEALTH]
 Brooch [- HUNGER]
 Ring  [+ LUCK]
 Gloves [+ SPEED]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/e67a8d085d0de46936ccd9fe0b2fb7f2442128f3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New Dialogue System: Waits for user input before removing dialouge text, Camera can pan to talking character, Differentiates between player dialouge and other character dialouge visually and audibly
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/9ae86df512b93de56abc4c8214e70b6ba4e649b7.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New Dialogue text animation
[*] Ultrawide monitor support
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/2c27e858a7c305d47df08814defa522757c1634d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] All party members start with their own equipment card.
[*] New Cards: Trap, Fur, Leather, Gold
[*] At the end of the last day of each level, we now give the player as much time as they need to organize their cards before continuing on the trail
[*] Rigged map / fortboard / encounter wagon and added a movement animation
[*] Made boosterpack models less flat
[*] Rename map to trail / new map front image
[*] New map location icons
[*] Different map design per map biome / add creases to map to show where it folds when open
[*] New map wagon selection / movement logic
[*] Re-do select next level deck selection screen to be more like the fort trader experience
[*] Added new doll idle sitting animation
[*] Make current recipe hover text easier to read / not look horrible
[*] Put a spinning wagon wheel as a visual indication that you are holding down spacebar, when skipping the firepit cutscene
[*] When you get a new altar item, turn the camera up to show the player
[*] Deck and Book fall down instead of sliding into view
[*] Deck now fans into place with sounds
[*] Made cursor bigger 
[*] Add sounds to UI menus
[*] New freezing and thawing sounds when the nightly temperature changes
[*] The cardgame now auto pauses when you leave the cardgame view (and you cant unpause / resume / fastforward until you go back to the cardgame view)
[*] Losing the game is more fun
[*] Pause cardgame at nighttime to show players that the simulation is not running at night, and auto start it again during the day
[*] Clean up wagon and various models, lighting
[*] Renamed DRUGS card to TONIC
[*] Add softer bead clink sound when not end of night
[*] [spoiler] coffee grinder handle needs to be put on instead of doing it automatically just like how the key works [/spoiler]
[/list] 

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix shader to not have a subtle gradient on the edge of shadows
[*] New party members acquired through random encounter no longer start starving
[*] Fix doll sitting animation so that the hands and arms are no longer disconnected from the rings
[*] [spoiler]Fix issue where you had to still open the coffin with the key in NG++ even if you unlocked the wanderer item[/spoiler]
[*] Initial deck building starter booster pack opening sequence was delayed
[*] [spoiler]During summoning the doll was floating off to the side instead of directly in front of camera[/spoiler]
[*] Cards going into the foodbox looked weird
[*] Lower sound of kill sound more lol
[*] [spoiler]Talking board no longer clips with wagon at end of summoning sequence[/spoiler]
[*] Remove sometimes hard to read messages above characters in favor of new Dialouge system
[*] If you craft a knife and kill someone in the tutorial you now get a proper game over where you can retry the tutorial, instead of just soft lock lol
[*] Remove any recipes before moving the cards back to the deck in the tutorial
[*] Fixed a couple of card dropping movement bugs
[*] Moving stacks at night are now moved to the closest location within the cardgame volume if dragged outside of the cardgame area when midnight strikes and we drop the moving cards (before they were being dropped off the playing area)
[*] Eggs were hatching into other eggs instead of chickens
[/list] 

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] New in between 'DAMAGED' state to make wagons not just instantly break
[*] Cutting meat off of carcasses and corpses now only gives you 3 MEAT instead of 5
[*] Oxen is slightly less common in booster packs
[*] When smithing ORE there is a small chance that a GOLD card will be produced instead of an IRON
[*] When mining there is a small chance that you find a GEM card
[/list]

notes.title: Demo build v0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Lots of improvements in this build. 

The biggest one is that I moved the time control lever and the abacus into the cardgame view:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225911/1941d2017f31ed6634f43aa9e58b1f45204e7f64.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add diegetic HUD elements into cardgame view (abacus, time control lever)
[*] When popping cards out of stacks allow cards to be automatically merged into containers of that type
[*] Simplify heating system plus add WARM status card
[*] Replace foodbox card with an in-universe foodbox 
[*] Rig foodbox and animate opening
[*] You can now press the time control lever symbols (pause, ff, resume) to immediately set that simulation speed instead of having to toggle cycle through
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] When a container of cards was sacrificed on the altar its contents was not being subtracted from the card supply amount 
[*] Fix bug where we were incorrectly detecting the cards that didnt fit in the container as collisions and needlessly moved the stack out of the way
[*] Fix card clipping issue for cards that do not fit in container after merging stacks
[*] You can now press "F" to fast forward the cardgame speed even if we are paused
[*] Freshly starved party members did not have the STARVED card status immediately after dying
[*] When you used a parts card to fix a wagon during the break wagon random encounter the parts card was still in your deck
[*] When selecting wagons at the end of the level, we now properly ignore broken wagons
[*] When a party member died in the random encounters their starving status card was still active
[*] Fix issue where people could get stuck during the puzzles
[*] Knife killing sound was too loud
[/list]

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] More expensive booster packs are now not totally random - It felt really shitty to spend 15 blood and get only some food in the wanderer pack. So I made the expensive booster packs all give 1 random 'rare' card and 2 random non rares.
[*] Pen shouldnt require a plank (its too hard to get the iron early game)
[*] Farm now requires 2 planks instead of 3 log
[*] Iron drop rate is now rarer in resource pack
[*] Wagon targeted explore recipes now preserve items so they can be reused (rod, sickle, etc)
[*] Iron smithing costs less resources: 1 ore and 2 coal now
[*] Ox card is now one of the rare cards in the wanderer pack

[/list]

notes.title: Demo build v0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to all of the people who played the demo!

After watching some streamers play the demo I decided to make some changes to the tutorial. I want to explain the game more for people completely lost, but I also want to leave a lot of things mysterious and discoverable by the player. 

I also added original music made by [url=https://pacificbell.bandcamp.com/album/zzen]PacificBell [/url] to the main menu, 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Typo where I dont know how to spell "Sacrifice" 
[*] Fix a couple of crashes that happened at night relating to egg hatching and egg laying
[*] Fixed bug where cards could spawn from a boosterpack right when night starts and those newly opened cards are interactable at night
[*] If you are over card supply limit and sacrificing cards to the altar, recipes were not respected when you move cards around
[*] Fix issue where you cant dismantle frozen houses / farms
[*] Dont allow removing container cards rom moving containers
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added original music to main menu
[*] New tutorial that should explain things better as well as give people the time to figure out how to play before the real game starts
[*] Resource page should be first in book recipes to showcase that first
[*] Added Screen Resolution and Display mode options in the settings menu
[*] Constrain the mouse to the game window to make windowed playing pleasant
[*] Better boosterpack open animation instead of just deleting them and instantly spawning the cards
[*] Added sounds to doll summoning / doll movements
[*] Tweaked timings of doll summoning 
[*] Added more sounds and polish to talking board segment
[*] Teach people that you can press WASD to leave the cardgame
[*] Keep all tutorial text up until you click card to go to next section
[*] Play the puzzle hint everytime you click the windchime
[*] Speed up opening of book
[*] Toggle open / closed book with tab key
[*] Change the '???' in the explore recipe book to something that indicates that it is the booster pack for this level type NOT random
[*]  Heating recipe book should say "OR" instead of "/"
[*]  Killing recipes are not intuitive, remove the human from them all and just make them a knife + card 
[*] Add unique knife killing sound when killing things / cutting pieces off of cards in the cardgame
[*] The recipe book was moving out to the left too far when being opened and was taking up too much space
[*] Made nightly card sacrifice message clearer
[*] Hide nightly card sacrifice message immediately once we reach that amount (instead of timing out)
[*] Center the settings menu
[*] Add missing dismantle recipes for (Pen, Quarry)
[/list]

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Soil should cost 2 blood (not 1)
[*] Bones should still fertilize farms
[*] Heating recipes should be faster
[*] Add a recipe that makes exploring faster if you have 2 oxen
[/list]
